summary: Concorde International Group Ltd., a Singapore-domiciled foreign private issuer, filed a Form 6-K reporting a grant of 20,000,000 restricted Class A ordinary shares on September 15, 2026 under its 2026 Equity Incentive Plan to certain employees as consideration for services. Following issuance, 226,759,450 Class A and 20,311,112 Class B ordinary shares are outstanding. No price, premium, advisor, or board recommendation is disclosed. This routine equity-compensation disclosure, the 6-K equivalent of a US Form 8-K Item 3.02/5.02 grant notice, presents no deal terms, no overhang from a transaction, and no risk-arb angle.
